description: PirateBox command vocabulary. This file is the single source of truth for which commands exist, their parameters and their ranges. The bridge validates every inbound command against it; anything not listed under 'commands' is rejected. The phone app and AI interpreter should load this same file.

message_format.parameters: object, optional - must match the command's parameter spec exactly (no extra keys)
message_format.confirmed: boolean, optional - must be true for commands with requires_confirmation
message_format.request_id: string, optional - echoed back in the result for correlation

play.description: Start playback. Does nothing if already playing.

record.description: Start recording: arm record if not armed, then start playback if not playing.

go_to_start.description: Move the playhead to the start of the song/pattern.

undo.description: Undo the last action in FL Studio.

save.description: Save the project (like Ctrl+S). An untitled project opens FL's Save As dialog on screen.

toggle_metronome.description: Switch the metronome on if off, off if on.

set_metronome.description: Switch the metronome explicitly on or off.

open_mixer.description: Show and focus the mixer window.

open_channel_rack.description: Show and focus the channel rack.

open_piano_roll.description: Show and focus the piano roll for the selected channel.

duplicate_pattern.description: Make a copy of the current pattern and switch to it.

mute_track.description: Mute or unmute a mixer track (0 = master, 1-125 = inserts).

solo_track.description: Solo or unsolo a mixer track (0 = master, 1-125 = inserts).

select_track.description: Select a mixer track (0 = master, 1-125 = inserts).

volume_up.description: Raise a mixer track's fader a small step (about 1.5 dB near 0 dB).

volume_down.description: Lower a mixer track's fader a small step (about 1.5 dB near 0 dB).

go_back_bars.description: Move the playhead back by a number of bars.

go_forward_bars.description: Move the playhead forward by a number of bars.

quantize.description: Quick-quantize the notes of the selected channel in the current pattern.

select_channel.description: Select one channel in the channel rack by its position (1 = top).

get_status.description: Diagnostics: check FL Studio is reachable and return its current state.

status_codes.PARSE_FAILED: Input text could not be understood as a command.
status_codes.INVALID_MESSAGE: Message was not a valid command object.
status_codes.UNKNOWN_COMMAND: Command is not in the whitelist (or is planned but not yet enabled).
status_codes.OUT_OF_RANGE: A parameter was outside its allowed range.
status_codes.FL_NOT_CONNECTED: The MIDI link ports to FL Studio could not be opened.
status_codes.FL_TIMEOUT: FL Studio did not answer (not running, or controller script not active).
status_codes.FL_REJECTED: The FL Studio script rejected the request (unknown opcode or bad arguments).
status_codes.FL_EXEC_ERROR: The FL Studio script raised an error executing the request.
status_codes.FL_VERSION_MISMATCH: Bridge and FL Studio script speak different link protocol versions.
status_codes.NOT_CONFIRMED: FL Studio acknowledged, but its reported state does not match the requested change.
status_codes.NO_EFFECT: Valid command, but there was nothing to act on (e.g. nothing to undo).
status_codes.NEEDS_CLARIFICATION: The AI couldn't map the request to a command; 'message' says what to try instead.
status_codes.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI interpreter could not be used (no key, no internet, service error). Exact commands still work.
